data.name: Girishbhai
data.gender_notes: Girishbhai is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Girishbhai is a Hindu name that means 'Lord of the Mountain'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Giri', which means mountain, and 'Bhai', which means brother or lord. This name is often given to boys in Hindu communities to signify strength, courage, and protection. It is also associated with the Hindu god Ganesha, who is known as the lord of the mountains and the remover of obstacles.
data.spiritual_meaning: Girishbhai is a powerful and spiritual name that is often associated with the Hindu god Ganesha. It represents the divine power of strength, wisdom, and protection. Those named Girishbhai are believed to possess these qualities and to be blessed with the divine grace of Ganesha.
data.etymology: Girishbhai belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Girishbhai total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
